lines: Patta patta boota boota haal hamara jaane hai.
couplets.en: Every leaf and every little plant knows what I am going through.

lines: Jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane.
Jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane, baagh to saara jaane hai.
couplets.en: Only the rose seems unaware, though the whole garden knows.
In the city of beauty, there is no custom of tending a lovesick heart.
In the city of beauty, there is no custom of tending a lovesick heart.
Otherwise, even the guileless beloved would.

lines: Warna dilbar-e-naadaan bhi is dard ka chaara jaane hai.
couplets.en: Otherwise, even the guileless beloved knows the remedy for this pain.
